nodes.summary: Provide bin/test.sh, the POSIX automated test runner with a slice selector.
nodes.instructions: Create bin/test.sh as a POSIX sh script that runs pytest -q from the application root against a real temporary database. Accept one slice selector argument that narrows the run to a named set of tests. Exit 0 only when every selected test passes.
nodes.name: Provide bin/test.sh, the POSIX automated test runner with a slice selector.

nodes.summary: Declare the persistence contract for the three ledger tables.
nodes.instructions: Declare accounts, categories, and transactions with the columns and keys in sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md Database. Store amounts as INTEGER cents with transactions.account and transactions.category as foreign keys. Declare an access pattern for each table operation the commands need. Drydock generates the persistence package and schema.sql; the builder writes no persistence code.

nodes.summary: Select the database from DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PATH, or data/app.db.
nodes.instructions: Resolve the DSN from DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. A postgres:// or postgresql:// value selects PostgreSQL; any other value is a SQLite path with an optional sqlite:// prefix. Use the persistence library's default connect timeout; an expired connect exits 1.
